# Architecture decision records

Use when a change picks between real alternatives that will be expensive to reverse: a database, a framework, a protocol, a module boundary, a security model.

## Write it
Create `docs/adr/NNNN-short-title.md` (follow the repo's existing location and numbering if it has one):

```markdown
# NNNN. Title in the imperative ("Use PostgreSQL for event storage")
Status: Proposed | Accepted | Superseded by NNNN
Date: YYYY-MM-DD

## Context
The forces at play: requirements, constraints, what is true today. Facts, with links.

## Options considered
1. Option A: pros, cons, cost.
2. Option B: pros, cons, cost.

## Decision
What we chose and the main reason.

## Consequences
What becomes easier, what becomes harder, follow-up work, and how we would know it was the wrong call.
```

## Rules
- One decision per ADR. Keep it under a page.
- Never edit an accepted ADR's decision; write a new one that supersedes it and link both ways.
- Record the decision in FORGE memory too so agents see it: `forge memory add --kind decision --content "..." --evidence docs/adr/NNNN-....md`.
